title: Declared input brief for the real research protocols
purpose: The declared input material for the real protocols whose single `analysis` phase declares `inputs: [input-brief:real_research_v1]` (`real_research_task_v1`, and `real_retrieval_research_v1`). The composition root stores exactly these bytes under that artifact id, and the run chain registers the object as a NON-MODEL source whose digest is recomputable from this file (GOAL-010 EC-02).
what_this_is: An operator-supplied brief: it states the task, the deliverable expectation, the constraints, and (since GOAL-011 EC-01) the retrieval parameters that a run-chain retrieval phase reads from here.
It is NOT a retrieval result and does NOT contain literature citations: the identifiers that enter the evidence chain come from the retrieval call itself, never from this file.
what_this_proves: A verifiable grounding relation between the deliverable and the material the task was supplied with (the digest is recomputable from this file).
It does NOT prove the session read it -- only a tool observation proves that, and a run-chain retrieval produces exactly such an observation (GOAL-011 EC-01).

retrieval.note: Read by the run chain only for protocols whose phase declares `capability_execution: run_chain` (today: real_retrieval_research_v1.yaml). `query` is the operator-declared search term; the identifiers read afterwards come from the search result itself, not from this file.

documents.title: Task
documents.text: Analyse the supplied subject and produce a single structured analysis report: what the subject does, the assumptions it rests on, the conditions under which it fails, and what evidence would be needed to settle the open questions.

documents.title: Deliverable expectation
documents.text: One report under the contract-declared artifact name. The contract judges that the artifact exists and that coverage is satisfied by a non-model source; it deliberately does not judge the report's content quality, and that limit is stated rather than hidden.

documents.title: Constraints
documents.text: Single task, single deliverable. The retrieval protocol declares exactly the retrieval it executes (one declared query, its result chained into one read); nothing beyond that is asserted as available. Multi-phase and parallel research is a later protocol's problem, not something to assert here.
